topic: Mutual Fund and ETF Fees and Expenses
source_evidence: Distribution fees cover the marketing and selling of fund shares, such as compensating brokers and others who sell fund shares.
question: Misconception: 12b-1 fees are charged directly to investors only when they buy or sell fund shares.
answer: Correction: 12b-1 fees are operating expenses paid out of fund assets, not just transaction fees charged when an investor buys or sells shares. They cover distribution costs, and can sometimes include shareholder service fees. These fees typically apply to mutual funds but not ETFs.
